historical_commentary.text: String handling utilities were essential in 4D v6 where built-in string functions were limited. Modern 4D has significantly expanded its string handling with built-in commands, regular expression support, and collection methods. Many of the specific utility methods described in this note would now be one-liners using modern 4D commands.
related_updates: Modern 4D includes extensive built-in string manipulation commands
Regular expression support via MATCH REGEX and related commands
Collection and object methods provide additional text processing capabilities
